name: molplot
description: MolPlot — Vega-Lite scientific charting with a unified, matplotlib-portable preset
author: Roy Kid

scripts.build:all: npm run build:core && npm run build:page
scripts.docs: npm run build:docs-assets && MOLPLOT_ELEMENTS_DIR=docs/assets/molplot zensical serve
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:docs-assets && MOLPLOT_ELEMENTS_DIR=docs/assets/molplot zensical build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:page && npm run typecheck -w examples-web
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:page && npm run test:python
